definition.simple: Anything that has weight and takes up space. If you can touch it, weigh it, or put it in a box, it's matter!
definition.academic: Anything that has mass and occupies space (volume).

common_misconceptions: Thinking gases like air are not matter because they are invisible.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask them if a balloon gets heavier when you blow air into it. (Yes, because air is matter and has mass!)
